toolArguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Nyamu neutral-presence time-night, UNKNOWN WEATHER, exact approved 1536x1024 source mother. Create F1 deliberate full foreground WHITE SELECTION MARKUP. ONLY input is that exact clean complete mother. Keep canvas, camera and every source coordinate absolutely unchanged; do not redraw identity, anatomy, pose, props, furniture or light.
Paint SOLID PURE WHITE over the ENTIRE visible girl and her ENTIRE held folded-paper fan. Include every lavender bob strand, fine separated hair-tip island, head/face/ears/neck, the thin black choker and hanging black ribbon ends, every fine shoulder strap, all gray ruffle blouse/sleeves/buttons, arms/wrists/hands/fingers, the COMPLETE paper fan INCLUDING dark fold lines and thin lower rim between fingers, black waist/skirt/all outer pleated hem tips, both bare thighs/knees/calves/ankles, and BOTH COMPLETE black ankle-strap shoes including each thin strap/buckle, dark toe/sidewall/sole/bottom/heel. Whole selected interiors are featureless pure white: no face, fold, finger, fan-rib, clothing or shoe detail left colored/gray inside. The fan and hands are ONE complete foreground, not hollow paper or unselected dark creases. Preserve real narrow outer antialias, actual empty gaps between hair strands/arms/legs/heel arch remain original COLORED room. No shrinking, growing or moving the outline.
This is selection only, not new person RGB. Every unselected source surface stays original colored: naturally pale closed curtains, cushion/linen/knit, plaid pillows, ceramic lamp/cup/flowers/books, round table, left shelves/desk/chair/plant, wood floor and rug. Independent local receiving cloth/floor/shadows also stay colored for later S selection. Do not mistake naturally white objects for deliberate selection. No boxes, grids, labels, text, checkerboard, crop, resize or transparency. One full opaque colored source scene with ONLY complete girl and held fan intentionally white.
CRITICAL continuous interior: the THIN BLACK CHOKER and BOTH dangling BLACK RIBBON ENDS lie on her skin/blouse and are part of the girl. Paint these fully PURE WHITE too, absolutely NO dark ribbon slits or neck lines inside the white silhouette. Do not confuse ribbon ends with empty background. All paper fan creases, blouse, fingers and legs are also solid white inside.
